summary_1line: After Rama humiliates Ravana, the demons desperately awaken the gigantic Kumbhakarna from his cursed sleep to send him into battle.

image_candidates.scene_text: Inside a vast cavern, thousands of demons beat drums, strike the colossal sleeping Kumbhakarna, and drive elephants over his body to wake him.
Kumbhakarna suddenly rises from sleep, yawning like a gaping hell-mouth, his enormous arms stretching as demons scatter around him.
The gigantic Kumbhakarna strides through Lanka toward Ravana’s palace, his mountain-like body shaking the earth as frightened creatures flee.
